_about: English source strings for the KruMath Tic-Tac-Toe project (krumath.com/tic-tac-toe). Fill in the "km" field for every string, then send this file back to have the translations applied in the codebase. The "en" values are the current (or proposed) copy; "where" explains where/how the string is used so it can be translated with the right tone.

_placeholders.{winLength}: marks in a row required to win (3-5)
_placeholders.{row}: 1-based row number of a board cell
_placeholders.{column}: 1-based column number of a board cell
_placeholders.{value}: the mark already in a cell: X, O, or the translated word for an empty cell
_placeholders.{name}: a difficulty name (Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, Impossible)
_placeholders.{draw}: the number of drawn games, a number

_do_not_translate: Tic-Tac-Toe (game name — confirm whether Khmer users should see a Khmer name instead)
_decisions_needed: The Donate button does not exist yet. Other KruMath games label it "គាំទ្រ KruMath" / "Support KruMath" (maze-rank), "បរិច្ចាគ" (khmer-type-master), or "Pay me a coffee!" (remember-face) and link to https://krumath.com/pricing. "Support KruMath" is proposed below.
The EN/KM language toggle does not exist yet, so no Khmer text is rendered anywhere today. The toggle is a UI change, not only a string change.
Khmer mode: confirm whether runtime numbers stay Western digits (as in remember-face) or Khmer numerals.

meta.title.where: Browser tab / Open Graph title for the game page.

meta.description.where: Meta description for the game page (shown in search results and link previews).
meta.description.en: Play Tic-Tac-Toe online against the computer.

meta.rootTitle.where: Fallback app title set in the root route before the game page overrides it.

meta.rootDescription.where: Fallback meta description set in the root route.
meta.rootDescription.en: Interactive games and learning tools from KruMath.

game.title.where: The single main heading above the board.

game.status.yourTurn.where: Status line under the board while the player is to move.

game.status.thinking.where: Status line under the board while the computer is deciding. Uses an ellipsis.

game.status.youWin.where: Status line under the board when the player wins.

game.status.aiWins.where: Status line under the board when the computer wins.

game.status.draw.where: Status line under the board when the game ends in a draw. Keep it short.

game.playAgain.where: Primary button under the status line; resets the board for a new game.

result.youWin.where: Large heading on the game-over card when the player wins. Distinct from the short game.status.youWin.

result.youLose.where: Large heading on the game-over card when the computer wins.

result.draw.where: Large heading on the game-over card when the game is a draw.

result.summary.where: Score line on the game-over card. {you}, {ai} and {draw} are numbers.

game.score.summary.where: Small score line under the board. The middle dot (·) is part of the design and can be changed.

game.difficulty.label.where: Screen-reader label for the difficulty dropdown. Never seen visually.

game.difficulty.option.where: Each option in the difficulty dropdown: the difficulty name plus its board size. {name} is a translated difficulty name, {size} is a number.

difficulty.beginner.where: Difficulty level name (weakest). Shown in the dropdown and reused by game.difficulty.option.

difficulty.easy.where: Difficulty level name. Shown in the dropdown and reused by game.difficulty.option.

difficulty.medium.where: Difficulty level name (the default). Shown in the dropdown and reused by game.difficulty.option.

difficulty.hard.where: Difficulty level name. Shown in the dropdown and reused by game.difficulty.option.

difficulty.expert.where: Difficulty level name. Shown in the dropdown and reused by game.difficulty.option.

difficulty.impossible.where: Difficulty level name (strongest, unbeatable). Shown in the dropdown and reused by game.difficulty.option.

board.label.where: Screen-reader description of the whole board. {size} and {winLength} are numbers.
board.label.en: Tic-Tac-Toe board, {size} by {size}, {winLength} in a row to win

board.cell.where: Screen-reader label for one board cell. {value} is X, O, or board.empty. {row}/{column} are 1-based numbers.

board.empty.where: Word for an empty cell, substituted into board.cell as {value}.

nav.home.where: Visible label of the Home button at the top-left; links to krumath.com/home.

nav.homeAria.where: Screen-reader label of the Home button. Never seen visually.

nav.github.where: Tooltip / screen-reader label of the GitHub icon button; opens the project repo in a new tab.

nav.donate.where: NEW button (missing today). Donation / support icon button (heart) linking to krumath.com/pricing. Used as tooltip and screen-reader label, so keep it short.

nav.language.where: Screen-reader label for the EN/KM language toggle group. Never seen visually.

lang.en.where: Visible label of the English option in the language toggle. Usually left as-is.

lang.km.where: Visible label of the Khmer option in the language toggle. Usually left as-is.

lang.switchToEn.where: Screen-reader label for the English option when Khmer is active.

lang.switchToKm.where: Screen-reader label for the Khmer option when English is active.

theme.label.where: Screen-reader label of the light/dark/system theme menu button in the header.

theme.light.where: Theme menu item that forces the light theme.

theme.dark.where: Theme menu item that forces the dark theme.

theme.system.where: Theme menu item that follows the operating system preference (the default).

account.label.where: Screen-reader label of the avatar/account menu button, and the fallback name before the profile loads.

account.fallbackName.where: Placeholder account name shown in the menu when the signed-in user has no email/name available.

account.settings.where: NEW item in the account dropdown (missing today); links to krumath.com/settings.

account.signOut.where: Item in the account dropdown; signs out of the shared KruMath session.

account.signIn.where: Button at the top-right shown when signed out; starts the KruMath sign-in flow.

auth.checking.where: Full-screen loading state while the KruMath account is being verified.

auth.redirecting.where: Full-screen state shown briefly before redirecting a signed-out user to the KruMath sign-in page.

error.notFoundBody.en: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

error.loadTitle.where: Heading shown when a page or the app fails to load. Also used by the plain server-rendered error page.

error.loadBody.where: Body text shown when a page or the app fails to load.
error.loadBody.en: Something went wrong on our end. You can try refreshing or head back home.

error.tryAgain.where: Button that retries rendering after an error.

error.goHome.where: Button on the 404 / error pages that returns to the game root.

error.goToKruMath.where: Link on the plain server-rendered error page that returns to krumath.com/home.
